subject: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenbyte.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook

Team — quick 48h playbook to make sure the GB-7453 commit actually lands in Q4. Short ask: stage confirmation + blocker + exact PO timing by EOD tomorrow (11/11). I attached a one-tab rollup template to capture the fields finance needs (ARR, ACV split, bill start, PO ETA).

Key rules for this cadence:
- Mark "Commitable" only if customer has either a signed PO or written legal approval to invoice this quarter.
- If the PO is "pending" but legal/ procurement has agreed on terms, put "Pending-Procurement" and include exact next-step owner and date.
- No refunds or exceptions in the grid — escalate to Lauren directly for pricing exceptions.

Initial asks by owner:
- Marissa: update stage + list any gating docs we still need from GB.
- Ben: verify capacity commit & expected start date (we need to avoid double-counting in monthly forecast).
- Priyom: confirm HubSpot deal contact + attach the latest redline if present.

Liam — looping you so we have a single place to track PO timing. If the procurement team at GreenByte can share the PO number or DocuSign link, paste it into the sheet and add the signer name.

Attachments: commit_rollup_template.xlsx (single tab), Q4_forecast_notes.pdf

Thanks — keep replies short (one line) so we can roll everything into finance by Friday close.

— Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenbyte.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook

Vivek — updated the sheet (tab: GB-7453) with the current gating items. Short version:
- Legal redline returned 11/09; they accepted our standard MSA but requested a one-off addendum for data retention. I attached the redline reference in the doc.
- Procurement at GB confirmed they expect a PO to be issued by 11/12 COB, pending C-level signoff.
- Revenue recognition start date: 11/20 (customer requested ramp week).

Marking current status as "Pending-Procurement" until we have the PO number. Will drop an in-thread update the moment we get the DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): GB_MSA_redline_v2.pdf (ref)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenbyte.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook

Quick capacity check and commit sanity: confirmed reserved pool available for GB's expected throughput. Two notes:
1) Start date confirmation — engineering needs exact ingest date to size node allocation (Marissa flagged 11/20). If that moves earlier than 11/18 we need heads-up to shift capacity.
2) Billing profile — GB requested monthly invoicing with net-30. If we do monthly instead of upfront, ARR recognition for Q4 will shift pattern. Not a blocker for the commit but flagging for finance forecast.

I'll keep status as "Commitable (conditional)" assuming PO arrives by 11/12 and billing terms don't change.

— Ben
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenbyte.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@procurely.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook

Thanks everyone — procurement update from my side: CFO verbally approved the spend yesterday. Procurement team ran a final check on our side and expects to issue the PO (DocuSign) by Thursday 11/12 morning. I copied Sarah from Procurely; she's helping with routing.

Two small asks from GB:
- Can Redwood mirror the billing contact name: "GreenByte Finance — accounts.payable@greenbyte.com" on the invoice?
- We requested a one-week ramp discount (10%) for the first month in the MSA redline; can Lauren confirm approval?

I'll paste the DocuSign link here when it comes through.

On Wed, Nov 10, 2026 at 08:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — quick 48h playbook to make sure the GB-7453 commit actually lands in Q4. Short ask: stage confirmation + blocker + exact PO timing by EOD tomorrow (11/11). I attached a one-tab rollup template to capture the fields finance needs (ARR, ACV split, bill start, PO ETA).

Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenbyte.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook

Folks — reviewed the request. Approving the 10% ramp credit for the first month as a one-time concession for GreenByte on the condition that:
- PO is signed by 11/12 COB and references the agreed billing contact.
- No further pricing concessions are requested after signature.

Finance (Priyom) — once the PO is in HubSpot and the invoice contact is confirmed, please update the ACV/ARR mapping in the sheet and mark the deal as "Commitable" so accounting can include it in the close.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenbyte.com>, Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@procurely.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit Concierge — 48h hygiene & forecast playbook

Final check — summary for finance close:
- Status: Commitable — PO issued (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/doc/GB-7453/po12345) [Liam confirmed].
- ACV: $180,000 (first-year) — split monthly invoicing net-30 per contract.
- Billing contact: accounts.payable@greenbyte.com (confirmed).
- One-time ramp credit: 10% for month 1 (approved by Lauren).
- Revenue start date: 11/20 (as per Marissa).

Actions complete: Marissa (legal redline captured), Ben (capacity confirmed), Priyom (HubSpot updated), Lauren (pricing exception approved).

Priyom — please push to the finance close grid and mark the deal closed-commit for Q4. I will send a short note to accounting to expect invoice schedule.

Thanks all — that wraps GB-7453. Please keep the same format for other late commits; this template made the difference.

— Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
